title.narrative: Widening democratic space, strengthening the rule of law and promoting respect for and protecting human rights in Thailand

description.narrative: The overall objective of this action is:To widen democratic space, strengthen rule of law and to promote and protect human rights in Thailand. This will be targeted by contributing to the human rights defenders capacity to engage on human rights issues while Royal Thai Government will have strengthened capacity to address human rights concerns as well as to uphold its human rights obligations including by implementing recommendations of the national and international human rights mechanisms, civil society and the judiciary.The specific objectives of the action are:To contribute to strengthening of national capacity to monitor and document human rights violations.To contribute to strengthening of capacity of the key government agencies, including law enforcement, to prepare them to effectively implement Thailands human rights obligations;Enhanced strategic and evidence-based advocacy leading to improvements on the human rights situation in Thailand.
